title: POST /api/v1/currency-gold-indices — one element of the request array (Lane 4: G8 Currency & Gold Index Suite)
description: Contract between currency_gold_index_engine.py (a fully separate process from export_collector_validator_v2.py / backfill_worker_api_gateway_v5.py -- see that script's module docstring for the isolation rationale) and the API Gateway. One JSON object = one index's computed value for the latest available M5 bar. The request body is an ARRAY of these (up to 9 per push cycle: 8 currency indices + XAUX). This stream is entirely separate from market_data, indicator_statistics and economic_events: its own endpoint, queue and table, and a failure here must never block or delay any of those. The gateway upserts idempotently on (index_name, bar_time) -- duplicate delivery is by design (push retries); re-pushed content for the same key is byte-identical.

terminal_id.description: Sender id; 'currency_gold_index_engine_v1' from the Lane 4 engine.

index_name.description: Which index this row is. The 8 currency indices are an equal-weighted (W=1/7) geometric basket of the G8 currencies against each other, verified byte-exact against the authoritative MQL5 indicator files in mql5-indicators/interesting-indicators/currency-and-gold-index/. XAUX is XAUUSD rebased to 100.00 at its own daily session open -- a different formula (simple ratio, no basket).

bar_time.description: UTC unix seconds of the M5 bar this value was computed for -- the latest bar available in that index's own input series at push time. Currency indices and XAUX have independent session-open times (00:00 vs 01:01 Eightcap server time), so their bar_time values can differ within the same push batch, e.g. during the gold rollover maintenance window.

value.description: The index level. Every index is rebased to exactly 100.00 at its own session-open bar by construction (the C_i normalization constant for currency indices; direct division for XAUX), so 100.00 is always the day's reference point -- there is no separate 'previousClose' to track.

change_pct.description: Percent change from session open. Because value is rebased to 100.00 at session open, this is always exactly (value - 100.00) -- a closed-form derivative of value, included for API convenience so consumers don't have to know that invariant.

session_open_bar_time.description: UTC unix seconds of TODAY's session-inception bar for this index (00:00 Eightcap server time for the 8 currency indices, 01:01 for XAUX -- the gold market's daily rollover-halt reopen). Stamped by the engine, which has ground truth of the documented Eightcap UTC-offset rule, so no downstream consumer (the Phase 3 read layer) ever has to re-derive today's session boundary via its own DST-offset logic. Repeats across every bar within one session; changes once daily at rollover.

x-gateway-requirements.batching: The request body is an ARRAY of these objects (up to 9 per cycle: one per index). The gateway enqueues one job PER ELEMENT so per-row idempotency is preserved across a batched request -- same pattern as gateway_contract_indicator_statistics.schema.json.
x-gateway-requirements.idempotency: Upsert on (index_name, bar_time). Duplicate delivery is by design (push retries); re-pushed content for the same key is byte-identical, since it is a deterministic recomputation from the same input bars.
x-gateway-requirements.isolation: This endpoint is independent of POST /api/v1/market-data, /api/v1/indicator-statistics and /api/v1/economic-events. Its failure must never affect any of those in any way -- it runs in a wholly separate OS process on the VPS with its own SQLite outbox file.

responses.400: Validation failure with JSON {message}. Engine quarantines to rejected_currency_gold_indices.jsonl AND stamps synced_at (poison-row guard, matching the statistics/events lanes).
responses.401/403: Auth failure -- engine halts this stream only.
responses.5xx: Transient; engine retries with backoff via its own HTTP session (2 retries, exponential backoff).
